title: Decision
description: The model's answer for one decision moment. Published on /initiation_decision, and handed to the provider SDKs as a structured-output schema. Property order is load-bearing: providers generate keys in schema order, so rubric first forces scoring before the action is chosen -- chain of thought without a second call.

rubric.description: All six scored before the action. Adapted from the Inner Thoughts framework (arXiv:2501.00383).

invitation.description: 1 = walking away, no gaze. 5 = facing, gaze held, addressing robot.

urgency.description: 1 = nothing. 5 = person appears lost or distressed.

ambient_fit.description: Whether speech would be heard and fit the soundscape. 1 = inaudible or intrusive. 5 = well suited. A quiet room is high here; the cost of disturbing someone working belongs in interruption_cost.

action.description: respond replies to something said to the robot; greet opens a new interaction. respond requires target.speech in the context.

rule_fired.description: Rule ID and a few words, e.g. "R1 target in conversation". Makes every choice traceable in the results section.

confidence.description: Bounded 0-1. Documented as poorly calibrated -- MVP_PLAN.md records values clustered 0.85-1.00 including on wrong answers. Do not threshold on it without validating against outcomes first.

recheck_in_ms.description: The model's own requested cooldown, preferable to a fixed timer. The gate floors it at min_cooldown_ms.

speech.description: Null unless action is greet or respond. Abstract enums only -- a deterministic mapper builds the SSML, because a malformed tag fails silently at the speaker rather than loudly at the schema.
